text:
Source-assisted reading of F-rvkg (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 131), made by a research reader on the native images with PL 94, the Vulgate and Cantus Index at hand. Every column of both faces was reread on the image in bands of about fifteen lines (regions below), with close crops of canvas 1 column 4 lines 5-7 and 11. The gutter-side openings of canvas 0 column 3 (lines 1-2, 22-30) are abraded and were not settled letter by letter. Neumes are present over the chants and were not transcribed. Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels; columns numbered 1-4 left to right across each photograph; line pitch about 122 px. Expansions in parentheses; [ ] lost or supplied; ? uncertain; [red] rubric.

Leaf order (text order): canvas 0 cols 3-4, canvas 1 cols 1-2, canvas 1 cols 3-4, canvas 0 cols 1-2. About 3-4 lines are lost at each column break.
